parameters.query:
UPDATE query_audit
SET
    pre_filter_verdict = CASE WHEN $1 = 'pre_filter_verdict' THEN $2 ELSE pre_filter_verdict END,
    query_classification = CASE WHEN $1 = 'query_classification' THEN $2 ELSE query_classification END,
    classification_confidence = CASE 
        WHEN $1 = 'classification_confidence' THEN $3::float 
        ELSE classification_confidence 
    END,
    rag_documents_retrieved = CASE 
        WHEN $1 = 'rag_documents_retrieved' THEN $4::jsonb 
        ELSE rag_documents_retrieved 
    END,
    api_calls_made = CASE 
        WHEN $1 = 'api_calls_made' THEN $4::jsonb 
        ELSE api_calls_made 
    END,
    draft_response = CASE WHEN $1 = 'draft_response' THEN $2 ELSE draft_response END,
    safety_verdict = CASE WHEN $1 = 'safety_verdict' THEN $2 ELSE safety_verdict END,
    safety_reason = CASE WHEN $1 = 'safety_reason' THEN $2 ELSE safety_reason END,
    final_response = CASE WHEN $1 = 'final_response' THEN $2 ELSE final_response END,
    total_latency_ms = CASE 
        WHEN $1 = 'total_latency_ms' THEN $5::int 
        ELSE total_latency_ms 
    END,
    llm_tokens_used = CASE 
        WHEN $1 = 'llm_tokens_used' THEN $5::int 
        ELSE llm_tokens_used 
    END,
    error_log = CASE 
        WHEN TRIM($6) != '' 
        THEN COALESCE(error_log || chr(10), '') || $6 
        ELSE error_log 
    END
WHERE request_id = $7::uuid;
